title: Vibrant Crunchy Dutch Chicken Tagine
description: A jammy and crunchy weeknight Dutch dish featuring red chilli flakes, cooked in a tagine style, and is low-calorie-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, red chilli flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and add the chicken, cooking until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped apricots, chicken broth, and browned chicken to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, cooking for 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the sliced almonds.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
